remarks: Spacious, bright and updated 1BR condo in secure well-managed building in downtown Stamford. Access this unit just off the elevator in a pristine community with concierge, fitness center, secure garage and laundry on site. Renovated kitchen, new appliances, hardwood floors, separate dining area, large living room w/balcony, private storage, and common courtyard with grills make this home ideal. The updated bathroom has a new vanity, sink and faucet. Newly renovated common areas include the lobby & hallways, gym and security desk. Pets are allowed with convenient access to four enticing parks. Great staff and management. 24 hour front doorman plus live-in building super. There is an additional $15.00 per month fitness room charge. Heat, cooling, and hot water included in HOA. This location offers everything you need in walking distance, including ample restaurants with patio seating, a vibrant social life and a variety of outdoor recreational activities. Near Metro North, I-95, parks, shopping, beach, and public transit. Live your best life at Hayes House.
